behavior: Represent approved intended architecture constraints and caller-supplied observed dependency witnesses with explicit coverage state.
Evaluate allowed dependency direction and relevant provider/data/contract boundary constraints deterministically; attach witness path/source, severity category, rationale and any exemption ID/expiry.
Keep implemented, planned, observed_in_run, unsupported and not_seen states distinct; missing mappings remain unknown/not_seen, not proof of absence.
Return incomplete coverage when the observed graph or required mapping is incomplete; do not emit a system-wide PASS.
exclusions: No automatic source refactoring, module movement, schema change, business requirement authoring or source tree scanner.
No uncalibrated risk percentage and no approval of intended constraints by the evaluator.
No claim that a partial observed graph proves conformance of the whole repository.

objective: Mô hình hóa ràng buộc kiến trúc đã duyệt và đối chiếu với bằng chứng phụ thuộc được cung cấp; trả drift có witness/source, mức độ, lý do, exemption/expiry và coverage; graph thiếu thì INCOMPLETE, không tự sửa kiến trúc.
verification_plan: C068: verify forbidden dependency witness and source, allowed direction, approved exemption/expiry, and incomplete graph coverage.
Verify implemented/planned/observed_in_run/unsupported/not_seen stay distinct and absent mapping never proves nonexistence.
Use synthetic evidence only; assert deterministic output, no auto-remediation and no risk percentage.
Run gofmt, focused architecture tests, import-boundary contract, go test ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./..., SPEC and delivery-policy checks.
